calculation.description: Measures recent 20-day trend relative to half the 60-day trend, scaled by 20-day log-return volatility. Cross-sectional percentile ranking and one-day lag prevent scale concentration and look-ahead. Positive values indicate stronger recent trend curvature.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in all three chronological partitions: 2020-2024 IC 0.05005 (1765 dates), 2025-2027 IC 0.04155 (943), 2028-2030-03-10 IC 0.03711 (560). Small cross-asset universe interpreted conservatively; dates use at least 8 valid instruments.
